top_signals.title: Paramount’s $41 Billion of M&A Bonds Slump as Trading Begins
top_signals.summary: Just hours after Paramount Skydance Corp. issued $52 billion of debt to fund the biggest Hollywood buyout ever, investors were nursing hundreds of millions of dollars in losses, triggering a flurry of angry calls from money managers to Wall Street banks that underwrote the debt.

top_signals.title: Hyperliquid Policy Center, Circle press EU on perps and stablecoin reserves in MiCA review
top_signals.summary: Hyperliquid's policy group wants perps under MiFID II, while Circle targets MiCA's bank deposit floor in filings to the European Commission's MiCA review.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
